_comment: Every value here is available in ALL templates as {{ site.xxx }}.
This is the Eleventy equivalent of PHP config constants.
For example, {{ site.name }} outputs your site name in any .njk file.
When reusing this boilerplate for a new project, update these
values and the entire site adapts automatically.
name: My Site
description: A short description of your site
_comment_seo: These are used in head-meta.njk for SEO and social sharing cards.
_comment_analytics: Google Analytics measurement ID. Leave empty string to disable.
_comment_bootswatch: Default Bootswatch theme loaded on first visit. Set to 'default' for plain Bootstrap. Set bootswatchSwitcher to false to hide the theme switcher in production.
_comment_fonts: Google Fonts URL. Leave empty string to use system fonts. Example: 'https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;700&display=swap'
_comment_webmanifest: PWA web app manifest config — templated into site.webmanifest.njk. Keep in sync with themeColor in style.css.
_comment_footer: Footer configuration. The 'pending' link points back to the main hub.
On the hub itself this link is auto-disabled since it would point to itself.
On other projects using this boilerplate, it becomes an active link back to the hub.
